🗓️ JULY 2026 — Little Johnny & The Horse Auction
😂
Little Johnny attended a horse auction with his father. He watched as his father moved from horse to horse, running his hands up and down the horse's legs, rump, and chest.
After a few minutes, Johnny asked, "Dad, why are you doing that?" His father replied, "Because when I'm buying horses, I have to make sure they are healthy and in good shape before I buy."
Johnny, looking worried, said, "Dad, I think the UPS Guy wants to buy Mom." 🤣😅😂
😂   😂
Little Johnny is Always in deep doo….
🗓️ AUGUST 2026 — Dang Drunks Are Funny!
🍺😂
A drunk gets up from the bar and heads for the bathroom. A few minutes later, a loud scream is heard. A few minutes after that, another loud scream through the bar.
The bartender goes in to check. "What's all the screaming about? You're scaring the customers!" — "I'm just sitting here on the toilet and every time I flush, something comes up and squeezes the hell out of my balls."
The bartender opens the door, looks in and says "You idiot! You're sitting on the mop bucket!" 😂
😂   😂
DANG DRUNKS ARE FUNNY!
🗓️ SEPTEMBER 2026 — Home Healthcare 😂
😂
With the rising cost of healthcare, I am now forced to conduct our medical exams at home. Just pee under a tree and wait a few minutes:
If ants gather = Diabetes.
If the grass dries up = High blood pressure.
If it smells like BBQ = High cholesterol.
If you forgot to pull your pants down = Alzheimer's.
😂   😂
Enjoying Life!
🗓️ OCTOBER 2026 — The Ferrari & The Officer
🚗👮😂
A man takes his new Ferrari for a spin and starts speeding. A police car chases him, but he pulls over, thinking it's not worth the risk.
The officer, nearing the end of his shift, wants to avoid paperwork and offers to let the man go if he can justify his speeding.
"Officer, my wife left me for a police officer. I thought you were bringing her back when you chased me!" 😂
